input.prompt:
ORIGINAL premium mobile 2D tower-defense map, 16:9 landscape, top-down / restrained 3/4 orthographic view, entire battlefield visible at once on a phone. Bright playful casual plant-defense readability with smooth chunky shapes, expressive props, saturated colors, soft cel shading and clean silhouettes. Do NOT copy any existing game map, character, texture, UI, road geometry or composition. Do NOT make it look like Kingdom Rush. No readable text, no lettering, no UI, no technical grid.

MAP 2 — POST-APOCALYPTIC OVERGROWN CITY — FINAL BASE TOPOLOGY.

TOPOLOGY MUST BE DIFFERENT FROM MAP 1:
- one single LEFT entry lane for the first ~25% of the level,
- then a clear Y-SPLIT into TWO genuinely separate combat routes,
- upper route curves through ruined storefronts and a radio tower,
- lower route curves around a flooded underpass/sewer canal and bunker district,
- the two routes remain separated for roughly 30–35% of the total path,
- they MERGE once near the final third,
- then one final single road exits at the RIGHT base.
- no second hidden combat path in BASE.
- no symmetric duplicate road shapes.

PLACEMENT TARGET:
Show exactly 12 obvious, countable build clearings/pads distributed so neither route is trivial:
- 3 before the split,
- 3 supporting upper branch,
- 3 supporting lower branch,
- 3 after/near the merge.
Keep them visually distinct but integrated into sidewalks/greenery. Avoid one pad covering both entire branches at once.

WORLD:
Abandoned colorful cartoon city reclaimed by vegetation: cracked asphalt, broken sidewalks, rusted small cars, collapsed bus shelter, ruined shop fronts, vines, flowers, rooftop gardens, drainage canal, overgrown concrete barriers, improvised barricades, a leaning communications mast, sewer pipes and a locked round bunker hatch. Friendly adventurous post-apocalypse, not grim horror.

ANIMATION-READY LAYERS/VISUAL CUES:
Leave visually separable elements for later animation: blinking amber hazard beacons, a slow-turning radio antenna, smoke/steam vents, flowing sewer water, light vines/leaves, loose papers/dust. Reserve a clear upper-right open zone for a future toxic dust storm overlay without obscuring the route permanently.

SECRET CUES:
A closed reinforced bunker hatch near the lower branch; a hidden maintenance door/tunnel; an overgrown radio node that can later unlock a special salvage tower. Keep secrets subtle but discoverable.

Lighting: bright overcast daylight with warm highlights. No event storm active in BASE. No enemies, no towers. Original IP only.
